text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало is ecstatic after winning the
Kikuka
Sho. Before her excitement wears
off, she calls up
her mother.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Surely now, her mother will recognize
her skill.
However, her mother's remarks
seem all too
superficial. Is she still not
convinced?
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The crowd also seems bent on bursting
King
Halo's bubble. Even in their cheer
and praise,
they refuse to acknowledge
her as anything but
"her mother's
daughter."
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The next day, it seems Кинг Хало has
done some
thinking alone. She asks me if
I'm ready to throw
everything away with
her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
